name: prime_gauge_field
summary: The Weyl-shaped local-scale connection built directly from Smith's Gamma(s)=(s-1)/(s+1) -- two candidate connections (grad(log|Gamma|), provably flat; (Re Gamma, Im Gamma) as a 1-form, genuinely not), closed-form curvature verified against finite differences, and the pre-registered flat-locus prediction checked honestly (partial match: real axis matches, the pole line sigma=-1 was not predicted).

provenance.origin: The 2026-09-21 gauge-field experiment (.claude/scratchpad/2026-09-21_smith_apollonian_uft_probe/) tested whether Gamma carries classical gauge curvature and found its Schwarzian derivative exactly zero -- a single global Mobius map, correctly flat. This module runs the Weyl-shaped question that result did not answer: make the scale connection local and test its curvature directly.

constants.role: Smith's conformal map, (s-1)/(s+1) -- the SCALE engine's own global chart
curvature of the (Re Gamma, Im Gamma) connection, closed form 2*Im(dGamma/ds)

environment.native_space: complex s-plane, s = sigma + i*t (the zeta-argument coordinate)
environment.arithmetic: complex float; closed forms verified against finite-difference numerics

menu.label: Prime Gauge Field
menu.blurb: The local-scale (Weyl-shaped) connection built from Gamma; two candidate curvatures, one provably flat, one genuinely not.

tools.name: verify
tools.label: Verify
tools.desc: closed form vs finite difference, flatness of the gradient reading, and the pre-registered prediction over 2000 random points

tools.name: report
tools.label: Report
tools.desc: one point, full readout: Gamma, the connection, both curvatures, the zero-locus check

tools.name: curvature
tools.label: Curvature
tools.desc: F(s) = 2*Im(dGamma/ds), the connection that is NOT flat

tools.name: log_potential_curvature
tools.label: Log-Potential Curvature
tools.desc: A=grad(log|Gamma|) -- always zero, for any holomorphic scalar

tools.name: prediction_check
tools.label: Prediction Check
tools.desc: the pre-registered flat-locus prediction, checked over a random sample
